G1.name: Overlay
G1.question: Transparent, frameless, always-on-top Electron island on Win11 at 100/150/200% DPI, multi-monitor, fullscreen-app detection
G1.passCriteria: Expand/collapse ≤ 150 ms, no focus stealing, idle delta ≤ 40 MB

G2.name: Local model sizing
G2.question: Which Ollama models run on 8/16 GB RAM, no GPU
G2.passCriteria: First token ≤ 5 s, ≥ 5 tok/s on reference laptop

G3.name: Local ASR upgrade
G3.question: Permissively licensed Whisper-class runtime, bundled or imported offline
G3.passCriteria: WER better than System.Speech on test set; licence MIT/Apache/BSD

G4.name: Input injection
G4.question: Reliable click/type-text across Win32/UWP/Chromium apps
G4.passCriteria: ≥ 95% on fixture matrix, never into elevated or password targets

G5.name: Windows mods
G5.question: Licence and safety of each third-party mod (Windhawk-style mods are often GPL)
G5.passCriteria: Catalog links/launches external tools only; no bundled GPL code; reversible

G6.name: Screen capture
G6.question: desktopCapturer region capture + local OCR (Windows.Media.Ocr via WinRT)
G6.passCriteria: Opt-in per capture, nothing stored by default

G7.name: Avatars/motion
G7.question: Renderer cost of 2D/3D avatar and motion scenes
G7.passCriteria: Within architecture §8 budget when idle; off by default

statusDefinitions.planned: No behavior in the repository beyond placeholders and unavailable-capability notices.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some behavior exists in the repository (module-tested or integrated), but part of the scope is missing, untested on its real path, not wired into the app, or gated.
statusDefinitions.verified: Every part of the scope is implemented, reachable through the app, and covered by a passing npm test or a recorded run in an existing doc. No open gap contradicts it. Module-only code never qualifies.

evidenceSchema.evidence: Array of {type, ref}. type is test (test file and title), smoke (recorded run in docs/current-verification.md), or doc (repo file reference).
evidenceSchema.limitation: Required string naming what is missing or unrecorded. Empty only in spirit: use "none" when verified with no gap.
evidenceSchema.owner: Owner area: main-api, native or ui-shell (see moduleOwnership).
evidenceSchema.experimentalGate: Experimental entries only: gate-defined when gates lists a G-id, missing when architecture section 10 defines no gate.

moduleOwnership.main-api: Shared contracts, backend services, IPC, store, chat, capsules, search and policy.
moduleOwnership.native: Electron main process, PowerShell helpers, speech, window and input helpers, DPAPI, packaging, tray and hotkey.
moduleOwnership.ui-shell: Navigation, dashboard, onboarding and settings screens, motion and avatar screens.

integrationVocabulary.none: No behavior in the repository for this scope.
integrationVocabulary.module-tested: Code and passing tests exist, but no part is reachable through the app (not in backend, IPC, preload or a mounted screen).
integrationVocabulary.integrated: At least one part is reachable through the app (backend, IPC, preload or a mounted screen). Module-only parts are named in the limitation.
integrationVocabulary.runtime-verified: A run recorded in an existing doc exercised the reachable behavior on Windows. Recorded runs predate the continuation and were not repeated.
